questions.subject: PHYSICS
questions.prompt: A particle is moving from rest to rest along a straight line covering a distance S in time t in two parts, with uniform acceleration followed by uniform retardation of same magnitude. The maximum velocity of the particle is
explanation_steps: Let a be magnitude of accel/retard. Time for each phase t/2.
v_max = a*(t/2). Distance total S = 2*(1/2 a (t/2)^2) = a t^2 /4 so a=4S/t^2.

questions.prompt: A loop of wire is moved parallel to a uniform magnetic field. The induced emf in the loop
options: depends on the area of the loop
depends on the shape of the loop
depends on the magnitude of the magnetic field
